insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Varus is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Varus in 19/48 games (40%): 2 picks (2-0) and 17 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Pantheon? They go Dr. Mundo
insights.text: Pantheon is a G1 favorite (6/17 G1s, played by KryRa). In the 20 later games where it was burned or banned, KryRa went to Dr. Mundo (3/20) and Xin Zhao (3/20).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they dig deeper than most
insights.text: In 14 G3+ games, 35/70 picks (50%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 41 champs in G1s, 48 in G3+.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They get stronger as the series goes deep
